difficulty_reason: Base change of global RHom out of perfect/pseudo-coherent M: constructs the canonical map via the global hom complex and restriction-extension adjunction; identifies the RHS as RHom_X(M, K ⊗ g'_*O_{X'}) by pull-push, checks RSheafHom(M, K) in D_QCoh, applies the evaluate-tensor isomorphism lemma (with the Tor-dimension verification of g'_*O_{X'} via three lemmas), and reduces to RGamma(X, K) ⊗ A' -> RGamma(X, K ⊗ g'_*O_{X'}) which is RGamma(X', Lg'^*K) by pull-push and lemma-compare-base-change.
